title: Rank 6 spells, a turned map and a torch
changes: The wizard's three spells now go up to rank 6; their upgrades stay at 3 ranks.
The big map (M) is turned like the world, so up on the map is up on the screen.
Quests sit at the top left on a see-through background; click a quest's title to fold it. Safe zone is now shown under the minimap, and the menu buttons are one row with their full names.
Press L to light a torch: at night it lights up a much wider circle around you.
